entities.summary: Paul Rey (b. 1992-05-23, Lunds Allhelgonaförsamling) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lunds Allhelgonaförsamling and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
